content.text: Paradise Season 2: Is Link Sinatra’s Son, Dylan? Is Alex A Time Travel Machine?[Spoiler Alert] So the seventh episode of Paradise Season 2 confirms that Link, one of the most mysterious characters of the show so far, was in reality Sinatra’s son, Dylan. Yes, I hear you. In the original timeline, Dylan died when he was a child. We all heard the doctors telling Sinatra and her husband, Tim, that they couldn’t do anything to save the young boy. And after Dylan’s death, Sinatra consulted a therapist, Dr. Gabriela Torabi, and told her that people say time helps, but in her case, it was actually making it worse by taking her further away from when she had her son.
